hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Hook launcher failed safely: cannot resolve git root.\"}}"; exit 0; }; exec "$root/.codex/hooks/run_hook.sh" pre_tool_use.py PreToolUse'

bash -lc 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PermissionRequest\",\"decision\":{\"behavior\":\"deny\",\"message\":\"Hook launcher failed safely: cannot resolve git root.\"}}}"; exit 0; }; exec "$root/.codex/hooks/run_hook.sh" permission_request.py PermissionRequest'

bash -lc 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { printf "%s\n" "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Hook launcher failed safely: cannot resolve git root.\"}"; exit 0; }; exec "$root/.codex/hooks/run_hook.sh" stop.py Stop'
